environment.limitation: Historical result files contain no runtime environment metadata.

input_provenance.limitation: The original matrix-generation command and source revision were not recorded; the curated input archives are preserved by SHA-256.

selection.bposd_logical: largest recorded nsim for each (distance, p); ties are rejected

stopping_rule.explanation: Before each parallel round, the remaining sample and failure budgets are ceiling-divided across workers. Aggregated nsim and error_count can therefore exceed the nominal limits recorded in the source filename by at most workers - 1.
